_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Operation and Maintenance Instructions for Research and Development (R&D) Equipment
summary: This DID provides government personnel the operating, diagnostic, and repair procedures needed to use and maintain R&D equipment supporting test assets.
use_relationship:
These operation and maintenance instructions provide government personnel the necessary operating, diagnostic, and repair procedures for using and maintaining R&D equipment supporting test assets.
a. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirements as delineated in the contract.
b. This DID is applicable only to R&D equipment not destined for the Air Force inventory.
c. This DID supersedes DI-MISC-81414.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Operation and Maintenance Instructions for Research and Development (R&D) Equipment shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The content shall be sufficient for technicians to operate the equipment and repair and replace components. The content shall include the following:

children.title: Complete operation and calibration instructions including safety hazards, if any.
Theory of operation, diagnostic tests, repair, and preventive maintenance.
Illustrations, diagrams, and schematics necessary to show interconnections between unit and associated equipment and assembly and installation of the unit and its components.
A parts list including commercial part numbers.
A test point list with normal voltages, currents, and waveforms.
A list of referenced documents or illustrations.
